original_card.question: Does one changed supplier or assembly claim lack a source-bound independent check of a specific new implication?
methods: Independently reconstruct a coordinated frame/circuit change and its single-change control, then derive the complete rank and physical ledger.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Read #2979 joint rank-7 end-frame proposal and the revision-6 evidence status. Its claimed kappa is not selected. Compare coordinated changes with the losing single-change controls and locate the complete physical ledger; an aggregate moment alone does not validate the mechanism.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Prioritize a bounded independent audit of #2979: reconstruct one joint group and its single-lowering control, check the declared frames/chronology, then trace changed children, idle widths and cleanup buffers into the complete invoice and both supplier caps. Choose one still-missing implication after checking existing audits. Stop with exact unresolved dependencies if full admission exceeds the session; do not launch a new lowering census on an unvalidated premise or substitute extra root digits for mechanism checking.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.
allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the primary function and calling its output independent verification.
Promoting #2979 from merged source archive to validated supplier solely from author PASS receipts or aggregate pricing.

actual_scope: Independently audit PR #3647 (head 36ff4414)'s composed R437 bit word: the helper464 joint GL deletion composed with #1043's helper470 deletion, against single-change controls #589+E464 (the PR's R438) and #589+E470 (#1043's R438, rebuilt). Covered: the exact F2 identity on all 659 inputs with arbitrary dirty helpers, by a forward replay and a reverse pull-back, plus the literal reverse orientation; literal reconstruction of R437 from selected #589; aligned-trace non-interaction; SOURCE77 frame-186 chronology and all SOURCE write boundaries; the local paid profile and its deltas; byte binding of the PR's 27,132-record stream to an independent lowering, with a record replay in both orientations; 18 required-failing mutants and one positive control.
scope_change_reason: The card's default object is a complex-moment/assembly claim. Orientation found that the selected #589 bit cap a/(1+a) = 0.0017304274698236 is only 8.57e-9 above the pending complex chain PR3653/PR3682 (kappa 0.0017304189). If that chain is admitted, the bit primitive binds and gains need an admitted better bit supplier. PR #3647 is the highest open bit claim (c = 0.001736628253427115) and had author checks only (PR3668 checks only histogram-to-c arithmetic). The card's method, reconstructing a coordinated change against its single-change controls, is applied to that supplier.
bottleneck_link: The word and record-level inputs of PR #3647's bit invoice are now independently checked, and the composition is shown to be non-interacting. If the bit side binds, the remaining unchecked steps before c could be admitted are the hosted matching/owner legality, the invoice/price, and the inherited assumptions. Today the complex primitive binds, so there is no kappa change.
stop_rule: Stop at the first of: a confirmed discrepancy (minimize with mutants); a full PASS of identity, composition, controls, chronology, profile and mutants with both methods agreeing; word semantics not pinned within about 60 min (hand off); or a PR head change (re-pin once). Outcome: full PASS. The hosted-invoice stretch was not attempted beyond a count-level split, so c is not validated.
evidence: PASS_INDEPENDENT_R437_WORD_AUDIT (RESULT.json). Identity: R437 (659 inputs) and controls #589 (661), #589+E464 = PR R438 (660) and #589+E470 = #1043 R438 (660, rebuilt) all map (x,y,h) to (x,y+x,h) over F2 with legal nested climbs and FULL/t-perp final frames. Forward replay and reverse pull-back agree entrywise; the reverse orientation passes; H1-H5/U/J hold; D0/C equal the rebuilt ones. Composition: #589+E464+E470 with rebuilt D0/C equals the PR's R437 except stats metadata. The E470 control reproduces #1043's FRAME-PATHS.json (660/661 paths), D0 18,085->18,030 and its profile. Non-interaction: E470 changes no projected value; E464 changes no clean column, only helper 340's dirt column at A2044/A2047/A2068/A2070 (two of them write retained totals 477/478) and their C inverses. The composed trace equals the E464 control's with h470 deleted at all 5,369 aligned gates. Profile deltas add: R437 {1:1320,2:1344,3:77,4:43,5:102,6:11,7:18}, mass 5,113, ADDs 24,208 (D17982/A2133/scatter527/B934/C2632). All 966 SOURCE write gates have identical projected full rows; all SOURCE climbs are unchanged (windowed). x77 is clean at the frame-186 read, reached at A426. Records: the PR stream (27,132 records, sha caeb2eb0...) is byte-identical to an independent lowering and passes record replay in both orientations. 18 mutants are rejected; the early-read mutant passes F2 identity and legality and is rejected only by the chronology check. The published whole profile splits as 288 x local + 32 x {2:431,4:444,6:444,7:666,34:2,42:11}, mass 1,808,352 (arithmetic only).
